serde_json::from_str(include_str!(\"../🧫️fixtures/🔣️.json\")).unwrap();\n    let coordinates = fixture[\"coordinates\"].as_array().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(coordinates.len(), CONTRIBUTIONS.len());\n    let descriptors: &[&[protocol::MutationLeafDescriptor]] = &[<semio_s_artifact_wfc_3d::editor::wfc3d::config::mutations::Wfc3dConfigMutation as Mutation<semio_s_artifact_wfc_3d::editor::wfc3d::config::Wfc3dConfig>>::DESCRIPTORS,<semio_s_artifact_wfc_3d::editor::wfc3d::transient::mutations::Wfc3dTransientMutation as Mutation<semio_s_artifact_wfc_3d::standards::v1::subsets::any::schema::snapshot::Wfc3dSnapshot>>::DESCRIPTORS];\n    for (row, contribution) in coordinates.iter().zip(CONTRIBUTIONS) {\n        let coordinate = &contribution.coordinate;\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.artifact, row[\"artifact\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.standard, row[\"standard\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.subset, row[\"subset\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.surface.unwrap_or(\"\"), row[\"surface\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.owner, row[\"owner\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        let prefix = format!(\"{}/\", coordinate.owner);\n        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();\n        let mut rows = Vec::new();\n        for descriptor in descriptors.iter().flat_map(|source| source.iter()) {\n            if !descriptor.owner.starts_with(&prefix) || coordinate.surface.is_none() && descriptor.owner[prefix.len()..].split('/').any(|segment| fixture[\"excludedOwnerSegments\"].as_array().unwrap().iter().any(|value| value.as_str() == Some(segment))) || !seen.insert(descriptor.semantic_kind) { continue; }\n            rows.push(json!({\"id\": descriptor.semantic_kind,\"variant\":descriptor.aggregate_variant,\"outcomes\":descriptor.outcome_classes.iter().map(|class| class.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>()}));\n        }\n        let mut expected = json!({\"schema\":\"semio.repository-test.runtime-inventory/v2\",\"artifact\":coordinate.artifact,\"standard\":coordinate.standard,\"subset\":coordinate.subset,\"bridgeVersion\":1,\"producedBy\":fixture[\"producedBy\"],\"mutations\":rows});\n        if let Some(surface) = coordinate.surface { expected[\"surface\"] = json!(surface); }\n        let mut arguments = vec![\"list-mutations\".into(),coordinate.artifact.into(),coordinate.standard.into(),coordinate.subset.into()];\n        if let Some(surface) = coordinate.surface { arguments.push(surface.into()); }\n        arguments.extend([\"--maximum-units\".into(),\"10000000\".into(),\"--maximum-owned-bytes\".into(),\"1048576\".into(),\"--budget-ms\".into(),\"60000\".into()]);\n        let mut observe = |_| Ok(());\n        let output = inventory_for_command(PRODUCED_BY, CONTRIBUTIONS, &arguments, &mut observe).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&output).unwrap(), expected);\n        println!(\"[DEBUG] child={} surface={} mutations={} bytes={}\", coordinate.artifact,coordinate.surface.unwrap_or(\"document\"),expected[\"mutations\"].as_array().unwrap().len(),output.len());\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn child_refuses_sibling_coordinate_and_retains_progress_cancellation() {\n    let mut args = vec![\"list-mutations\".into(),\"s.unowned.sibling\".into(),\"1\".into(),\"any\".into(),\"--maximum-units\".into(),\"10000000\".into(),\"--maximum-owned-bytes\".into(),\"1048576\".into(),\"--budget-ms\".into(),\"60000\".into()];\n    let mut observe = |_| Ok(());\n    assert_eq!(inventory_for_command(PRODUCED_BY, CONTRIBUTIONS, &args, &mut observe).unwrap_err(), MutationInventoryError::Coordinate);\n    args[1] = CONTRIBUTIONS[0].coordinate.artifact.into();\n    let mut callbacks = 0;\n    let mut observe = |_| { callbacks += 1; Err(MutationInventoryError::Cancelled) };\n    assert_eq!(inventory_for_command(PRODUCED_BY, CONTRIBUTIONS, &args, &mut observe).unwrap_err(), MutationInventoryError::Cancelled);\n    assert_eq!(callbacks, 1);\n}\n",

      "source": "//! 🏭️ Owner-local production mutation inventory; all coordinates and descriptors belong to this artifact.\nuse semio_framework_os_kernel as protocol;\nuse protocol::Mutation;\nuse semio_framework_test_mutation_inventory::{inventory_for_command, replication_inventory_leaves, MutationInventoryContribution, MutationInventoryCoordinate, MutationInventoryError, MutationInventoryLeaf, MutationInventoryProgress};\nuse std::io::Write;\n\nconst PRODUCED_BY: &str = \"semio-wfc-mutation-bridge\";\nconst LEAVES_0: [MutationInventoryLeaf<'static>; <semio_s_artifact_wfc_grid3d::standards::v1::subsets::any::schema::mutations::Grid3dMutation as Mutation<semio_s_artifact_wfc_grid3d::standards::v1::subsets::any::schema::snapshot::Grid3dSnapshot>>::DESCRIPTORS.len()] = replication_inventory_leaves(<semio_s_artifact_wfc_grid3d::standards::v1::subsets::any::schema::mutations::Grid3dMutation as Mutation<semio_s_artifact_wfc_grid3d::standards::v1::subsets::any::schema::snapshot::Grid3dSnapshot>>::DESCRIPTORS);\n\nconst CONTRIBUTIONS: &[MutationInventoryContribution<'static>] = &[\n    MutationInventoryContribution { coordinate: MutationInventoryCoordinate { artifact: \"s.wfc.grid3d\", standard: \"1\", subset: \"any\", surface: None, owner: \"✏️s/🔌️plugins/🀄️wfc/🗿️artifacts/🧱️grid3d/🏅️standards/🔖️1/🪆️subsets/✳️any\" }, aggregates: &[&LEAVES_0], excluded_owner_segments: &[\"👁️viewer\", \"✏️editor\"] },\n ];\n\nfn run() -> Result<(), MutationInventoryError> {\n    let arguments: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();\n    let mut last = std::time::Instant::now();\n    let mut observe = |progress: MutationInventoryProgress| {\n        if last.elapsed().as_secs() >= 1 {\n            eprintln!(\"[mutation-inventory] units={} bytes={}\", progress.completed_units, progress.emitted_bytes);\n            last = std::time::Instant::now();\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    };\n    let output = inventory_for_command(PRODUCED_BY, CONTRIBUTIONS, &arguments, &mut observe)?;\n    let mut stdout = std::io::stdout().lock();\n    stdout.write_all(&output).map_err(|_| MutationInventoryError::Output)?;\n    stdout.write_all(b\"\\n\").map_err(|_| MutationInventoryError::Output)\n}\n\nfn main() {\n    if let Err(error) = run() { eprintln!(\"[mutation-inventory] {error}\"); std::process::exit(1); }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\n#[path = \"🧪️tests/🦀️.rs\"]\nmod tests;\n",

      "path": "✏️s/🔌️plugins/🀄️wfc/🗿️artifacts/🧱️grid3d/🏭️bridge/🧪️tests/🦀️.rs",
      "source": "use super::*;\nuse serde_json::{json, Value};\n\n#[test]\nfn portable_coordinates_match_original_production_descriptor_oracle() {\n    let fixture: Value = serde_json::from_str(include_str!(\"../🧫️fixtures/🔣️.json\")).unwrap();\n    let coordinates = fixture[\"coordinates\"].as_array().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(coordinates.len(), CONTRIBUTIONS.len());\n    let descriptors: &[&[protocol::MutationLeafDescriptor]] = &[<semio_s_artifact_wfc_grid3d::standards::v1::subsets::any::schema::mutations::Grid3dMutation as Mutation<semio_s_artifact_wfc_grid3d::standards::v1::subsets::any::schema::snapshot::Grid3dSnapshot>>::DESCRIPTORS];\n    for (row, contribution) in coordinates.iter().zip(CONTRIBUTIONS) {\n        let coordinate = &contribution.coordinate;\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.artifact, row[\"artifact\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.standard, row[\"standard\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.subset, row[\"subset\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.surface.unwrap_or(\"\"), row[\"surface\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.owner, row[\"owner\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        let prefix = format!(\"{}/\", coordinate.owner);\n        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();\n        let mut rows = Vec::new();\n        for descriptor in descriptors.iter().flat_map(|source| source.iter()) {\n            if !descriptor.owner.starts_with(&prefix) || coordinate.surface.is_none() && descriptor.owner[prefix.len()..].split('/').any(|segment| fixture[\"excludedOwnerSegments\"].as_array().unwrap().iter().any(|value| value.as_str() == Some(segment))) || !seen.insert(descriptor.semantic_kind) { continue; }\n            rows.push(json!({\"id\": descriptor.semantic_kind,\"variant\":descriptor.aggregate_variant,\"outcomes\":descriptor.outcome_classes.iter().map(|class| class.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>()}));\n        }\n        let mut expected = json!({\"schema\":\"semio.repository-test.runtime-inventory/v2\",\"artifact\":coordinate.artifact,\"standard\":coordinate.standard,\"subset\":coordinate.subset,\"bridgeVersion\":1,\"producedBy\":fixture[\"producedBy\"],\"mutations\":rows});\n        if let Some(surface) = coordinate.surface { expected[\"surface\"] = json!(surface); }\n        let mut arguments = vec![\"list-mutations\".into(),coordinate.artifact.into(),coordinate.standard.into(),coordinate.subset.into()];\n        if let Some(surface) = coordinate.surface { arguments.push(surface.into()); }\n        arguments.extend([\"--maximum-units\".into(),\"10000000\".into(),\"--maximum-owned-bytes\".into(),\"1048576\".into(),\"--budget-ms\".into(),\"60000\".into()]);\n        let mut observe = |_| Ok(());\n        let output = inventory_for_command(PRODUCED_BY, CONTRIBUTIONS, &arguments, &mut observe).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&output).unwrap(), expected);\n        println!(\"[DEBUG] child={} surface={} mutations={} bytes={}\", coordinate.artifact,coordinate.surface.unwrap_or(\"document\"),expected[\"mutations\"].as_array().unwrap().len(),output.len());\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn child_refuses_sibling_coordinate_and_retains_progress_cancellation() {\n    let mut args = vec![\"list-mutations\".into(),\"s.unowned.sibling\".into(),\"1\".into(),\"any\".into(),\"--maximum-units\".into(),\"10000000\".into(),\"--maximum-owned-bytes\".into(),\"1048576\".into(),\"--budget-ms\".into(),\"60000\".into()];\n    let mut observe = |_| Ok(());\n    assert_eq!(inventory_for_command(PRODUCED_BY, CONTRIBUTIONS, &args, &mut observe).unwrap_err(), MutationInventoryError::Coordinate);\n    args[1] = CONTRIBUTIONS[0].coordinate.artifact.into();\n    let mut callbacks = 0;\n    let mut observe = |_| { callbacks += 1; Err(MutationInventoryError::Cancelled) };\n    assert_eq!(inventory_for_command(PRODUCED_BY, CONTRIBUTIONS, &args, &mut observe).unwrap_err(), MutationInventoryError::Cancelled);\n    assert_eq!(callbacks, 1);\n}\n",

      "source": "#!/usr/bin/env bun\n/** 🏭️ Runs only this artifact's contributed production mutation inventory. */\nimport {resolve} from \"node:path\";\nimport {runMutationInventoryCargoProducerCommand} from \"../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧪️test/🎮️mutation/🏭️inventory/🏃️execution/🚪️command/🟦️.ts\";\nimport {readMutationInventoryExecutionPolicy} from \"../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧪️test/🎮️mutation/🏭️inventory/🏃️execution/🟦️.ts\";\nimport {acquireCargoBuildLeaseV1} from \"../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🏃️process/📦️artifacts/🏗️native-build/🔒️lease/🟦️.ts\";\nimport {readCargoTestPolicyV1,runCargoTestsV1} from \"../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🏃️process/🧪️testing/🦀️cargo/🟦️.ts\";\nconst manifestPath=resolve(import.meta.dir,\"../📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.toml\"),cwd=resolve(import.meta.dir,\"..\");\nif(process.argv[2]===\"check\"){\n  if(process.argv.length!==3)throw Error(\"check accepts no overrides\");\n  const controller=new AbortController(),cancel=()=>controller.abort(),policy=readMutationInventoryExecutionPolicy(process.env);\n  process.once(\"SIGINT\",cancel);process.once(\"SIGTERM\",cancel);\n  if(process.env.CARGO_TARGET_DIR!==policy.compilerStorage.targetDirectory||process.env.CARGO_BUILD_BUILD_DIR!==policy.compilerStorage.buildDirectory)throw Error(\"Compiler custody differs from the authored child policy\");\n  const lease=await acquireCargoBuildLeaseV1({directory:policy.compilerStorage.leaseDirectory,buildDirectory:policy.compilerStorage.buildDirectory,args:process.argv.slice(2),signal:controller.signal,onWait:()=>console.error(\"[mutation-inventory]  finally{lease.release();process.off(\"SIGINT\",cancel);process.off(\"SIGTERM\",cancel);}\n}else await runMutationInventoryCargoProducerCommand({manifestPath,binary:\"semio-wfc-bitmap-mutation-bridge\",cwd});\n",

\"✏️s/🔌️plugins/🀄️wfc/🗿️artifacts/◻️2d/🏅️standards/🔖️1/🪆️subsets/✳️any\" }, aggregates: &[&LEAVES_0, &LEAVES_1, &LEAVES_2], excluded_owner_segments: &[\"👁️viewer\", \"✏️editor\"] },\n       "source": "use super::*;\nuse serde_json::{json, Value};\n\n#[test]\nfn portable_coordinates_match_original_production_descriptor_oracle() {\n    let fixture: Value = serde_json::from_str(include_str!(\"../🧫️fixtures/🔣️.json\")).unwrap();\n    let coordinates = fixture[\"coordinates\"].as_array().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(coordinates.len(), CONTRIBUTIONS.len());\n    let descriptors: &[&[protocol::MutationLeafDescriptor]] = &[<semio_s_artifact_wfc_2d::editor::wfc2d::config::mutations::Wfc2dConfigMutation as Mutation<semio_s_artifact_wfc_2d::editor::wfc2d::config::Wfc2dConfig>>::DESCRIPTORS,<semio_s_artifact_wfc_2d::editor::wfc2d::transient::mutations::Wfc2dTransientMutation as Mutation<semio_s_artifact_wfc_2d::editor::wfc2d::transient::Wfc2dTransient>>::DESCRIPTORS,<semio_s_artifact_wfc_2d::standards::v1::subsets::any::schema::mutations::Wfc2dMutation as Mutation<semio_s_artifact_wfc_2d::standards::v1::subsets::any::schema::snapshot::Wfc2dSnapshot>>::DESCRIPTORS];\n    for (row, contribution) in coordinates.iter().zip(CONTRIBUTIONS) {\n        let coordinate = &contribution.coordinate;\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.artifact, row[\"artifact\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.standard, row[\"standard\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.subset, row[\"subset\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.surface.unwrap_or(\"\"), row[\"surface\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        assert_eq!(coordinate.owner, row[\"owner\"].as_str().unwrap());\n        let prefix = format!(\"{}/\", coordinate.owner);\n        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();\n        let mut rows = Vec::new();\n        for descriptor in descriptors.iter().flat_map(|source| source.iter()) {\n            if !descriptor.owner.starts_with(&prefix) || coordinate.surface.is_none() && descriptor.owner[prefix.len()..].split('/').any(|segment| fixture[\"excludedOwnerSegments\"].as_array().unwrap().iter().any(|value| value.as_str() == Some(segment))) || !seen.insert(descriptor.semantic_kind) { continue; }\n            rows.push(json!({\"id\": descriptor.semantic_kind,\"variant\":descriptor.aggregate_variant,\"outcomes\":descriptor.outcome_classes.iter().map(|class| class.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>()}));\n        }\n        let mut expected = json!({\"schema\":\"semio.repository-test.runtime-inventory/v2\",\"artifact\":coordinate.artifact,\"standard\":coordinate.standard,\"subset\":coordinate.subset,\"bridgeVersion\":1,\"producedBy\":fixture[\"producedBy\"],\"mutations\":rows});\n        if let Some(surface) = coordinate.surface { expected[\"surface\"] = json!(surface); }\n        let mut arguments = vec![\"list-mutations\".into(),coordinate.artifact.into(),coordinate.standard.into(),coordinate.subset.into()];\n        if let Some(surface) = coordinate.surface { arguments.push(surface.into()); }\n        arguments.extend([\"--maximum-units\".into(),\"10000000\".into(),\"--maximum-owned-bytes\".into(),\"1048576\".into(),\"--budget-ms\".into(),\"60000\".into()]);\n        let mut observe = |_| Ok(());\n        let output = inventory_for_command(PRODUCED_BY, CONTRIBUTIONS, &arguments, &mut observe).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&output).unwrap(), expected);\n        println!(\"[DEBUG] child={} surface={} mutations={} bytes={}\", coordinate.artifact,coordinate.surface.unwrap_or(\"document\"),expected[\"mutations\"].as_array().unwrap().len(),output.len());\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn child_refuses_sibling_coordinate_and_retains_progress_cancellation() {\n    let mut args = vec![\"list-mutations\".into(),\"s.unowned.sibling\".into(),\"1\".into(),\"any\".into(),\"--maximum-units\".into(),\"10000000\".into(),\"--maximum-owned-bytes\".into(),\"1048576\".into(),\"--budget-ms\".into(),\"60000\".into()];\n    let mut observe = |_| Ok(());\n    assert_eq!(inventory_for_command(PRODUCED_BY, CONTRIBUTIONS, &args, &mut observe).unwrap_err(), MutationInventoryError::Coordinate);\n    args[1] = CONTRIBUTIONS[0].coordinate.artifact.into();\n    let mut callbacks = 0;\n    let mut observe = |_| { callbacks += 1; Err(MutationInventoryError::Cancelled) };\n    assert_eq!(inventory_for_command(PRODUCED_BY, CONTRIBUTIONS, &args, &mut observe).unwrap_err(), MutationInventoryError::Cancelled);\n    assert_eq!(callbacks, 1);\n}\n",
